1.0: Oh you really got it! So this is the tail of Samiho, the three-tailed fox. It's so soft and smooth. Thanks, and here's the rice wine. I'm sure my stepmom will love this.

yes.0: If you need more rice wine down the road, please come see me! Just know that I can only make it #bonce#k a day...

item.0: Bring me 3 tails of Samiho and I'll give you some Rice Wine.

0.0: Long time no see. Have you made your way around town?\r\n#L0# #bCan I get some Rice Wine?#k
0.1: Rice Wine? Well, I have some leftover from my stepmom. My stepmom makes a very delicious Rice Wine, but I seriously cannot give them to you for free; she'll be very mad with me for that. She won't be mad, however, if you bring her something that she has been looking for.

yes.0: My stepmom really likes foxtails, especially the ones of the three-tailed fox known as Samiho. I heard it's very furry and warm, perfect for cold weather. If you can get me #b3 tails of Samiho#k and #b1,000 Mesos#k, I'll give you the rice wine, and I don't think my stepmom will be too angry with it.

no.0: Aren't you here because you needed Rice Wine?

QuestInfo.name: Kong Ji's Rice Wine
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, the place that makes the best Rice Wine in Korean Folk Town is Kong Ji's...
QuestInfo.1: I went to Kong Ji's tavern because apparently her place was the best at making rice wine in Folk Town. She asked for 3 Three-Tailed Foxtails and 1,000 Mesos in return for some rice wine.\n\n#t4000172# #b#c4000172##k/3
QuestInfo.2: I gave Kong Ji 3 #t4000172#s and 1,000 mesos for 5 bottles of rice wine.
